Healthcare and Life Sciences cloud will move to the new Industry solutions cloud metric.

Industry solutions brings together our vertical commercial offerings across Dynamics, Linkedln, and Healthcare including:

and Healthcare and Life Sciences cloud, previously reported in Azure
· Industry solutions products, which is the on-premises portion of these businesses
